headline: President Clinton authorized calling members of the military's Selected Reserve up to active duty.
what_it_does: This order allows members of the Selected Reserve of the U.S. Armed Forces to be ordered to active duty. The Selected Reserve includes part-time service members in the Reserve and National Guard who train regularly. The title does not say how many people could be called, for how long, or for what mission.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Selected Reserve, including Reserve and National Guard units
who_it_affects.how: They could be ordered to leave their civilian lives and serve on full-time active duty.
They could lose workers for a time while those workers serve on active duty.
They could be separated from family members who are called to serve.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 8, 1995; the title does not state a separate start date.
